stem.alt: Two vertical arrows labelled force, one pointing up and one pointing down, joined by a horizontal double-headed arrow labelled perpendicular distance between the forces.

stem.text: How is the torque of the couple calculated?

A.text: $\dfrac{1}{2} \times$ perpendicular distance between the forces $\times$ magnitude of one of the forces

B.text: perpendicular distance between the forces $\times$ magnitude of one of the forces

C.text: perpendicular distance between the forces $\times$ magnitude of the sum of the forces

D.text: $2 \times$ perpendicular distance between the forces $\times$ magnitude of one of the forces
